name: Right Atrium LGE-MRI Segmentation Benchmark
description: A framework and benchmark for segmenting the right atrium cavity from late gadolinium-enhanced (LGE) MRI scans.
reputation: Used within the cardiac image-analysis community for benchmarking right atrium segmentation methods, but has a narrower user base than large public medical benchmarks.
notes: Medical imaging benchmark requiring expert annotations; typically small-to-moderate dataset size, scanner/protocol variability, and non-LLM benchmark.
